info.name: Useful Calls 👤👤👤
info.description:
**GET Categories List** - Retrieves all available system categories with identifiers, names, and hierarchical relationships. Essential for populating dropdown menus and filtering options.

**GET Database Update Dates** - Returns timestamp information for technology modifications. Critical for cache invalidation, synchronization processes, and determining data freshness across distributed systems.

**GET Relationship Tag Types** - Fetches available relationship tag types used to categorize connections between entities. Provides structured data including identifiers, display names, and usage contexts for relationship mapping.

**GET Credits Available** - Retrieves current credit balance and usage information for authenticated users. Returns available credits, consumed amounts, and expiration dates for billing and access control.

Contact us for more examples!

Updated 2026-11-10 from https://api.builtwith.com/llms-full.txt. Set KEY locally. Requests are examples; sending data requests may consume credits. Optional query parameters are disabled until selected.
